channel.description: Latest articles from Holy City Sinner (holycitysinner.com)

item.title: Lowcountry Cajun Festival set for April 18 at James Island County Park
item.description: The Lowcountry Cajun Festival is back this spring at James Island County Park! Charleston’s favorite ragin’ Cajun celebration will be held on Saturday, April 18, 2026 from 12 – 6 p.m.

item.title: Local Artist Brings Kiawah’s Native Flora to Life in New Coffee Table Book
item.description: Nearly 200 native Lowcountry plants come to life in “Native Plants of Kiawah Island: A Collection of Watercolors,” a striking new coffee table book by local artist Audrey Straus.

item.title: Jelly Roll to Perform at Credit One Stadium on June 7
item.description: Rapper and singer Jelly Roll will bring his Little ASS Shed Tour to Credit One Stadium on Sunday, June 7 at 7 p.m. Tickets are on sale now.

item.title: Charleston Weekend Events
item.description: There’s ALWAYS something to do in Charleston – especially on the weekend. If you need help finding plans, just consult Charleston’s best events list below.

item.title: Benjamin Garner, Former Federal Prosecutor, Strengthens Maynard Nexsen’s White Collar Defense Bench
item.description: Maynard Nexsen is pleased to announce that Benjamin N. “Ben” Garner has joined the firm as a Shareholder in the Government Investigations & White Collar Defense Practice Group.

item.title: Commentary: Prepare Yourself for Charleston
item.description: The Census Bureau named South Carolina the nation's fastest-growing state from 2024 to 2025. While steady, Charleston’s growth is modest compared to the explosive growth of its suburbs with Johns Island’s population up 94% since 2010

item.title: Trudy B. Grant Joins AfroSouth Film Festival Advisory Board
item.description: Trudy B. Grant has joined the advisory board of the AfroSouth Film Festival.

item.title: Chef Daniel Humm Introduces À La Carte Menu to The Charleston Place Residency This Spring
item.description: Chef Daniel Humm x The Charleston Place, Presented by Resy launches a new à la carte spring menu on Wednesday, March 4 at The Charleston Place.

item.title: RiverDogs unveil 2026 single-game promotions celebrating “Land of the Free, Home of the Fun" in celebration of America's 250th Birthday
item.description: Stars, stripes and sizzling summer nights are on deck as the “Land of the Free, Home of the Fun” takes center stage at Joseph P. Riley, Jr. Park in 2026 as baseball returns and America turns 250.

item.title: SCETV to provide live coverage of Rev. Jesse Jackson memorial events in South Carolina
item.description: South Carolina ETV and Public Radio (SCETV) will provide live broadcast coverage of memorial events honoring the life and legacy of the Rev. Jesse Jackson.
